content: R automated report patterns: easystats/report package generates narrative summaries following APA style — model type + performance + parameter estimates + effect interpretation + uncertainty (95% CI + p-values). Key patterns: (1) always emit CI alongside point estimates; (2) use standardized language templates per statistic type; (3) separate interpretation from raw numbers; (4) one caveat paragraph per known limitation. modelsummary for tables, report for narrative, rmarkdown/knitr for rendering. CRAN-clean approach: rmarkdown/knitr in Suggests, requireNamespace() guarded. Multi-format: html_document + pdf_document + word_document output formats in rmarkdown. The report package exemplifies the pattern: report(model) → textual narrative; as.data.frame(report(model)) → table. Parallel in EventStudy: es_advise(diag, 'report_writing') → narrative; generate_report(task, advice=advice) → rendered HTML/PDF.
